subject: SOC 2 readiness sync & artifacts plan
body:
From: Karen Liao <security@horizonlabs.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: mark.santos@horizonlabs.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 readiness: artifacts request and quick sync?

Hi Dylan,

We are starting our SOC 2 readiness work for Horizon Labs and would like to kick off an intake with Redwood so we can align on the evidence you’ll need and the cadence for uploads. We have a CAIQ export from our side (attached) and a short list of compliance windows.

Big asks up front:
- Can we schedule a 30-minute intake call to confirm owners and sequencing? Preferred windows: Wed 5/13 10:00am PT or Wed 5/13 3:00pm PT.
- High-level evidence we expect to collect: data retention policy, encryption at rest/process diagrams, access control lists, and sample logs.

I attached our CAIQ export (horizon_caiaq_export_20260512.json) — it’s partial but should help prioritize. Please loop in whoever owns evidence collection on your side.

Thanks,
Karen Liao
Security Manager
Horizon Labs
(attachment: horizon_caiaq_export_20260512.json)

---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liao <security@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 readiness: artifacts request and quick sync?

Karen — thanks for the CAIQ and the note. Wed 5/13 3:00pm PT works for us. I’m looping in Marissa (Customer Success) to handle uploads and Mina from Security/Compliance to confirm technical artifacts.

Pre-call ask (attached): redwood_soc2_precall_matrix.xlsx — please fill the columns for owner and estimated delivery date if you can before the call. If you can’t, no problem; we’ll capture owners during the meeting.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
1) Introductions + scope (5 min)
2) Evidence inventory review (10 min)
3) Upload mechanisms & timelines (5 min)
4) Action items and owners (10 min)

Call details: Zoom link (sent separately).

See you Wed,
Dylan
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_soc2_precall_matrix.xlsx)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liao <security@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Mark Santos <mark.santos@horizonlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 18:15:00 -0700
Subject: Meeting notes: SOC 2 intake call (May 13)

Hi all — thanks for the sync earlier. Notes and agreed actions below. I’m attaching a PDF with the cleaned notes for your records (redwood_meeting_notes_20260513.pdf).

Summary:
- Scope: SOC 2 Type II readiness for services used in production (API + embeddings). Horizon Labs will provide evidence for customer-configured controls; Redwood will provide service-level evidence (logs, deployment diagrams, KMS attestations).
- Key milestones: Evidence handoff window targeted May 21–28; auditor review window provisionally June 7–21.

Action items (owner — due):
- Horizon: Upload initial set (data retention policy, IAM role list, sample user access list) — owner: Mark Santos — due: 2026-05-21.
- Horizon: Provide CAIQ gaps matrix (completed rows in shared matrix) — owner: Karen Liao — due: 2026-05-18.
- Redwood: Provide system architecture diagram (KMS, network boundary, logging) and KMS key policy excerpt — owner: Mina Haddad — due: 2026-05-17.
- Redwood: Deliver redacted sample API access logs and a short README describing log fields — owner: Marissa Cole — due: 2026-05-17.
- Redwood: Provide temporary auditor access guidance and a short checklist for prior evidence upload — owner: Dylan Brooks — due: 2026-05-14.

Notes & clarifications:
- We confirmed Redwood can provide encrypted-at-rest proof (KMS policy excerpts) and can produce a 30-day sample of API access logs scoped to Horizon’s customer ID. Redwood will work with Horizon to identify exact log slices.
- Upload method: Horizon to share evidence in the shared Drive folder (link below); for sensitive items parties can request a secure S3 upload URL from Marissa.

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-horizon-soc2
Related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-412

Next sync: tentative check-in week of 5/18 if needed.

Thanks,
Dylan
(attachment: redwood_meeting_notes_20260513.pdf)

-Mark (on behalf of Horizon compliance)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liao <security@horizonlabs.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meeting notes: SOC 2 intake call (May 13)

Hi Karen/Mark — auditors accept a mix. We typically provide:
- KMS policy excerpt showing key rotation and access control (redacted to org-level principals)
- Console screenshot of key metadata (creation date, key id) with any sensitive IDs redacted
- If needed, a short signed attestation on company letterhead describing KMS controls (we can provide this to auditors on request)

I’ll upload the policy excerpt and a sanitized console screenshot by 5/17.

— Mina
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
